Fix issue #2: Restructure keybindings in tmux-agents.tmux. Current bindings use prefix+g then single keys (g/n/N/a/A/d/D/r/R/o). New proposal from the user:
- prefix+a p → create new pane reusing current session (currently prefix+g a behavior — attach existing session in pane)
- prefix+a P → create new pane with NEW session (currently prefix+g n — prompt for new session name, open in pane)  
- prefix+a w → create new window reusing current session (currently prefix+g A — attach in window)
- prefix+a W → create new window with NEW session (currently prefix+g N — prompt new session, open in window)
- prefix+a a → switch current pane to existing session via fzf (currently prefix+g g)
- prefix+a A → attach current pane with new session
- Keep d/D for dashboard, r/R/o for pane rotation, Esc to cancel.
The trigger key option @tmuxagents-trigger-key should still work (default changes from g to a). Update tmux-agents.tmux with new bindings, update README.md keybindings table, update all references. Branch: feat/issue-2-keybinding-rework. Closes #2.
